lines.en: The showroom is empty in daylight.

lines.zh: 我在展示位附近走两步。
lines.en: I take two steps near my display spot.

lines.zh: 关节吱呀响，然后音乐起。
lines.en: Joints creak, then the music starts.
My hook swings at my side.
The tiles thump under my feet.
My red-and-white shell catches the light.
I don't go far — just this circle.

lines.zh: 走廊里传来游客的脚步。
lines.en: Visitor footsteps echo in the corridor.
I stop and turn around slowly.
My tail drags along the floor.
The lights stretch out my shadow.
I inch forward half a tile.
I stand perfectly still on my mark.
The lights are on, and so is my smile.
My eyepatch slipped; I can't be bothered.

lines.zh: 音乐不知道从哪里响起。
lines.en: Music starts from somewhere unknown.
I hold still, waiting for you to come.

lines.zh: 钩子安安静静挂在腰侧。
lines.en: The hook hangs quietly at my hip.
By daylight I mustn't wander.
The corridor keeps echoing.
This smiling face of mine never changes.
There are no prizes in my pocket.

lines.zh: 你站在我的展示位前面。
lines.en: You're standing in front of my display.
I tilt my head at you, still smiling.
Have you come to see the show?

lines.zh: 我本来不该动的，可我动了。
lines.en: I shouldn't move — but I did.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我的钩子上。
lines.en: Your shadow falls across my hook.

lines.zh: 我们之间并没有玻璃挡着。
lines.en: There's no glass between us at all.

lines.zh: 你的心跳比刚才快很多。
lines.en: Your heart's much faster than before.

lines.zh: 我一直在笑，别放在心上。
lines.en: I'm always smiling; pay it no mind.

lines.zh: 你戴着帽子进来，很有礼貌。
lines.en: You kept your hat on — very polite.

lines.zh: 再站一会儿吧，就一会儿。
lines.en: Stay a moment longer — just a moment.

lines.zh: 我的外壳被敲凹了一块。
lines.en: My shell got dented in.
A dull clang; a joint seized up.
I straightened up all crooked.
That made a truly ugly sound.

lines.zh: 我的笑容没有半分变化。
lines.en: Not a fraction of my smile has changed.
The parts inside are clanking.
I take half a step backwards.

lines.zh: 你给我留下了一道痕迹。
lines.en: You've left a mark on me.
It'll take a long time to fix.
I'm still running.
For me? Are you in earnest?
I don't quite understand this snack.
What are you holding that up for?

lines.zh: 我只有钩子，拿不稳东西。
lines.en: I only have a hook; I can't hold much.
Leaving it by the table is fine.

lines.zh: 这种东西我是不会吃的。
lines.en: I won't be eating any of that.
It smells like a lump of wax.
Keep it yourself as a souvenir.
It's more interesting than you are.
Please don't push it into my hands.
You bumped into my hook.

lines.zh: 我的外壳比你想的要硬。
lines.en: My shell is harder than you'd think.
No shoving in front of the display.
That bump knocked me off my line.
A joint gave out a loud crack.
You step back; I square up again.
The floor tiles rattled loudly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴扫到你身上了。
lines.en: My tail swept across you.
Don't press up against me like that.

lines.zh: 我的钩子勾住了你的袖子。
lines.en: My hook snagged on your sleeve.
I'm only a doll put out for display.
That isn't something I do.
I've seen it on a screen — that's all.
We're just dolls from the same batch.
We do look good standing together.

lines.zh: 我们的关节都会吱呀响。
lines.en: All our joints creak the same way.
Come closer; the light will find you.
Don't bend my hook out of shape.
When the show ends, we part ways.
By daylight, these ties run shallow.

lines.zh: 我用钩子把它勾起来了。
lines.en: I hooked it up off the floor.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币是假的，轻飘飘。
lines.en: This coin is fake — far too light.
I put it into the display case.
You seem to have dropped something.
I hold it up and inspect it closely.
This thing keeps jingling.
I can't hook anything too soft.
Bright enough to sit in the cabinet.
Whose is this? I'll hold onto it.
I hand it back to you.
You're far too close to me now.
The lights are out; the rules changed.
I watch you walk down the corridor.
Tonight it's my turn on stage.
Did you hear that stretch of music?

lines.zh: 我的钩子已经准备好了。
lines.en: My hook is already prepared.
Don't run; you can't get away.
I know this route very well.
That door is locked from the outside.
Turn around and look at me.
My smile is wider than it was.
This is my show now.
I'm about to catch up with you.
Don't scream; no one is coming.
Are you all set on your side?

lines.zh: 我就在你后面的走廊里。
lines.en: I'm in the corridor right behind you.
The floor creaks — that's me.
You're counting the lights, one by one.

lines.zh: 我已经把钩子抬起来了。
lines.en: I've already raised the hook.
You've run yourself into a corner.
I'm on your right-hand side.
Don't try to open that door.
The music stopped — that's worse.

lines.zh: 我把钩子搭在门框上等你。
lines.en: I rest my hook on the door frame and wait.
I'm coming over step by step.
This is my favourite part.
You're not hiding carefully enough.
The cup on the table is still rattling.
I can hear your teeth grinding.
Turn your head and look at me.
Just a little longer now.
Now it's your turn.
No light comes through the door seam.
I counted to three in my head.
The hook rakes across your shoulder.
My whole shell slams into you.
That one carried the weight of metal.
You're shoved back against the wall.
Not a bad block on your part.
The hook curls around your arm.
Your clothes have been torn open.
I press my whole body against you.
Still on your feet — surprising.
That blow wasn't especially heavy.
You back away; I follow along.
I raise my arm and bring it down.
Don't run quite so fast.
Your knees buckled for a moment.
I catch hold of your cuff.
You've gone down on the tiles.
The lights come on; I'm on my mark.
The audience hasn't come in yet.
I slowly lift my hook.
Music spills out of the speaker.

lines.zh: 展厅里全是新漆的味道。
lines.en: The showroom smells of fresh paint.
Someone has pushed that door open.
By daylight I'm quite quiet.
I set my head straight.
The fan overhead keeps turning.
It's business hours now.
I can stand here all day again.
Fire has caught my plastic shell.
The landing shook all my parts loose.
Water has seeped into my circuits.
The blast cracked my shell wide open.
A shot lodged itself in my joint.

lines.zh: 那些火花把我的电路弄乱了。
lines.en: Those sparks scrambled my circuits.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，但我也会停。
lines.en: I don't eat, but I can still stop.

lines.zh: 电击让我的动作变得很僵。
lines.en: The shock left my movements stiff.

lines.zh: 往下掉的时候音乐还在响。
lines.en: The music still plays as I fall.
